metadata.description: `shell.json` — the self-description carried inside one documentation shell (PROP-057 `##SHELL-XTASK-EMBED`, `##SHELL-RELATIVE`). The build records the package coordinate, the address base and island marker it built into the shell, and the count and digest of the opaque shell files. A reader uses those named facts instead of guessing from file names. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/doc_shell_index/`.
The shell-index shape version. Epoch 1 is the only version this reader accepts.
The web package this shell was built from, in `<group>/<name>` form. Empty only for the built-in fallback, which is not a package build and is never published as `shell.json`.
The version of the web package this shell was built from. Empty only for the unpublished built-in fallback.
The address prefix the shell's template and assets were built under. The local reader uses it as the source prefix when mounting the same shell elsewhere.
The exact marker in the route template that the rendered documentation island replaces.
The number of shell payload files, excluding this index.
The lowercase hexadecimal tree digest measured over the shell payload, excluding this index so the record does not hash itself.
